batching.normative_policy_listing:
IF COUNT(ready, ALL) > 3 OR MAX(truck, status, ALL) = 1
    THEN FIRE(transporting)
ELSE POSTPONE

choice_sl.normative_policy_listing:
IF COUNT(phone_delivered, ALL) > 0 AND SUM(phone_delivered, on_time, ALL) /
      COUNT(phone_delivered, ALL) < 0.95
    THEN FIRE(phone_production)
ELSE IF COUNT(game_delivered, ALL) > 0 AND SUM(game_delivered, on_time, ALL) /
           COUNT(game_delivered, ALL) < 0.95
    THEN FIRE(game_production)
ELSE IF COUNT(game_demand, ALL) > 0
    THEN FIRE(game_production)
ELSE FIRE(phone_production)

ratelimit.normative_policy_listing:
IF SUM(machine, nr_exec_a, ALL) / CLOCK < 0.4
    THEN FIRE(process_a)
ELSE IF SUM(machine, nr_exec_b, ALL) / CLOCK < 0.25
    THEN FIRE(process_b)
ELSE POSTPONE

priority.normative_policy_listing:
IF MAX(waiting_1, priority, ALL) <= MAX(waiting_2, priority, ALL)
    THEN FIRE(process)
ELSE POSTPONE
